```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ 'both',
    chocolate ~ 'chocolate',
    fruity ~ 'fruity',
    .default = 'other'
  ))

#Table
top5_chocolate <- candy %>%
  filter(type == "chocolate") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = winpercent, n = 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(winpercent)) %>%
  mutate(Chocolate_Win_Percent = paste0(round(winpercent), "%")) %>%
  select(Chocolate_Candy = competitorname, Chocolate_Win_Percent)

top5_fruity <- candy %>%
  filter(type == "fruity") %>%
  slice_max(order_by = winpercent, n = 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(winpercent)) %>%
  mutate(Fruity_Win_Percent = paste0(round(winpercent), "%")) %>%
  select(Fruity_Candy = competitorname, Fruity_Win_Percent)

top5_side_by_side <- bind_cols(top5_chocolate, top5_fruity)
#count(candy, type)


```


# Data Plots

## Row 1

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: 'Total Candies'

list(
  icon = 'basket',
  color = 'warning',
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Fruity Candies Win %"
#| icon: hypnotize
#| color: danger

fruity_win <- mean(subset(candy, type == "fruity")$winpercent, na.rm = TRUE)
paste0(round(fruity_win, 1), "%")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Chocolate Candies Win %"
#| icon: heart-fill
#| color: blue

chocolate_win <- mean(subset(candy, type == "chocolate")$winpercent, na.rm = TRUE)
paste0(round(chocolate_win, 1), "%")
```

## Row 2

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

candy_summary <- candy %>%
  filter(type %in% c("chocolate", "fruity")) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(avg_winpercent = mean(winpercent, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(candy_summary, aes(x = type, y = avg_winpercent / 100, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(avg_winpercent / 100, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = -0.5, 
    fontface = "bold") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("chocolate" = "#5C3A21", "fruity" = "#FF4081")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Win Rate: Chocolate vs. Fruity Candy",
    x = "Candy Type",
    y = "Average Win Percent") +
  theme_linedraw()

    
```

# Data Table

This dataset describes individual candies and comes from the 'candy' package. This table showcases the top 5 fruity and chocolate candies that were ranked the "best".
